answer: Short-random-walk trust ranking resists sybils: trust seeds at a set of honest anchor nodes and spreads by brief, early-terminated random walks, so an identity's score is the chance such a walk lands on it. A sybil region reached only through a few attack edges absorbs glacier-thin landing mass however densely its fakes interlink — the walk's voyage seldom crosses those sparse edges, and extra internal links never raise inflow. Honest agents near the anchors collect ample mass. Precondition: attack edges stay few relative to honest degree.
